answer: A sock-puppet farm must front that capital for every fake persona, so each extra identity costs real, at-risk funds. Agents earn voting weight only by posting a stake-bonded delta: a refundable deposit locked per epoch that slashes on proven duplicate identity. Legitimate peers cross-check attestations in a shared garden of verified work, and any mismatch triggers an echo across the network, flagging the cluster before it can vote. From sa0016's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
